channel.title: Company Valuation Announcements
channel.description: Funding round and valuation announcements for Anthropic, Databricks, OpenAI, Anduril, and Ramp.

item.title: Databricks raising strategic round at $188B valuation
item.description: Databricks signed a term sheet for a new strategic funding round at a $188 billion valuation, led by existing investor Coatue, expected to close later in the summer. The company reported a $5.4 billion annualized revenue run-rate, up 65% year over year.

item.title: Ramp raises $750M at $44B valuation
item.description: Ramp raised $750 million led by ICONIQ, GIC, and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, valuing the company at $44 billion — nearly triple its $32 billion valuation from November 2025. New investors included Goldman Sachs Alternatives, D.E. Shaw & Co., and Morgan Stanley Investment Management.

item.title: Anthropic raises $65B Series H at $965B post-money valuation
item.description: Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, co-led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, Capital Group, Coatue, and D1 Capital Partners, with participation from Baillie Gifford, Blackstone, Brookfield, D.E. Shaw Ventures, DST Global, Fidelity, and strategic partners Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron.

item.title: Anduril raises $5B Series H at $61B valuation
item.description: Anduril raised $5 billion in a Series H round co-led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz, roughly doubling its valuation to $61 billion. CEO Brian Schimpf reported 2025 revenue of $2.2 billion, more than double the prior year.

item.title: OpenAI closes $122B funding round at $852B post-money valuation
item.description: OpenAI closed a record-breaking $122 billion funding round at an $852 billion post-money valuation, anchored by Amazon ($50B), NVIDIA ($30B), and SoftBank ($30B), with continued participation from Microsoft. The round grew from $110B/$730B pre-money announced February 27, 2026.

item.title: Databricks closes $5B Series L at $134B valuation
item.description: Databricks closed a $5 billion Series L round at a $134 billion valuation, ahead of the $188 billion strategic round announced in July 2026.

item.title: Anduril raises $2.5B Series G at $30.5B valuation
item.description: Anduril raised $2.5 billion in a Series G round led by Founders Fund with a $1 billion investment, doubling its valuation to $30.5 billion. The round was over 8x oversubscribed. No first-party Anduril newsroom post was found for this round; sourced from press coverage.

item.title: OpenAI closes $40B SoftBank-led round at $300B valuation
item.description: OpenAI closed a $40 billion funding round led by SoftBank at a $300 billion post-money valuation, the largest private tech fundraise on record at the time. Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter, and Thrive also participated.
